messages:
Elaine (partnerships): Vendor A just flagged a partial SKU swap on our reserved shipment for PO R-4432 — they say 25% of the SKUs were substituted with 40GB variant due to packaging constraints. This affects 3 racks we were counting on in May.
Sam (procurement): Ugh. Do we have an official change notice? can we see which serials/lot numbers?
VendorBot: [automated] Change notice uploaded: https://vendor-a.example.com/notice/R-4432 (doc id: cn-7791). ETA update included: two racks delayed by 10–14 days, one rack swapped to 40GB SKU, ship date unchanged.
Elaine (partnerships): Link checked. They attached a customs note too; the swapped SKU requires different EDI code which may delay import clearance.
Marcos (eng-infra): The 40GB variant is compatible but has slightly different VRAM profile — we need to re-run perf sims for the canary pool. Not a showstopper but could change packing density on Dedicated nodes.
Priya (sales): We have two enterprise trials scheduled for June that were promised Dedicated capacity. Should we proactively notify customers?
Sam (procurement): Action items: 1) Ask Vendor A for confirmed serials for swapped racks; 2) Request prioritized shipping for the two delayed racks if possible; 3) Confirm whether swapped SKU will be labeled in the manifest for customs. I'll ping the account rep now.
Elaine (partnerships): I already pinged account rep — they replied: "Can expedite customs docs and bump priority on one delayed rack to next flight for additional fee." Quote attached in change notice.
Marcos (eng-infra): For canary: I can run a quick perf delta using the 40GB model locally — give me the SKU ID and I'll bench. If perf delta > 7% latency for our 2k token workload, we should adjust route rules to prefer non-swapped racks for latency SLOs.
Sam (procurement): PO snippet for tracking:\n```
PO: R-4432
Orig SKUs: AX-80GB x3 racks
Reported Swap: AX-40GB x1 rack
Vendor change id: cn-7791
```

Elaine (partnerships): @Priya -- recommend we tell the two trial customers that capacity is still on track but we may route a small % of requests to alternate region for the first week. Less alarming than "delay" and gives us breathing room. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (sales): Agreed. I'll draft messaging that highlights redundancy and will wait for confirmed serials before sending. Keep it to a single line: "We're monitoring a minor hardware substitution — performance and SLA unaffected so far; we'll update if anything changes."
VendorBot: [automated] Account rep update added to thread: "Will cover expedited shipping fee for one rack; customs forms to be prioritized."
Sam (procurement): If they cover expedited fee, let's take it. Also ask for written confirmation that swapped rack meets our thermal and power spec (max 1.2kW/rack). Need that for floor planning.
Marcos (eng-infra): Got it. If they confirm power/thermal and serials, I can reserve the swapped rack into canary pool and run tests by EOD tomorrow. If not, we'll keep it in standby and pull from marketplace/fallback capacity for the trials.
Elaine (partnerships): I'll push vendor for serials + thermal confirmation + expedited shipping confirmation. Target: get all docs by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (sales): Notifying customers tentatively tomorrow after we have vendor confirmation. I'll keep messaging light and operational.
Sam (procurement): I'll also check our marketplace partners for on-call replacement racks in case customs stalls. If we need to swap, we'll route purchase orders to marketplace partner X — currently lead time < 7 days for hot-swap.
Elaine (partnerships): Great — I'll update this thread when vendor replies. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
